claims.verbatim:
Steamship America (Brem.), Meyer, Bremen, Aug. 12, at 6:45 a. m.,
via Southampton 15th, at 1:45 p. m., with mdse. and pass. to Oelrichs
& Co. Had westerly winds most of the passage. Aug. 17[?], lat. 79[?] 51,
long. 8 59, passed British ship Gorilla, bound W.

Ship Gorill[?], Jolly, from Liverpool for New-York, Aug. 18, lat. 49,
long. 13.

Aug. 30, lat. 45 40, long. 33 35, Br. ship Gorilla, from Liverpool for[?]
New-York, 19 days out.

Steamship Circassian, Ellis, Antwerp, Aug. 18, Havre 20th, and
Halifax Sept. 15, with mdse. and 189[?] pass. to Continental Mail Steam-
ship Co. All Well. Had very heavy westerly gales since leaving the
Channel; Aug. 27, 3 a. m., disabled the engine and was eight days
under canvas with westerly winds; made temporary repairs and pro-
ceded as far as long. 64, and the winds still westerly, and the supply of
coal becoming short, bore down for Halifax, where she arrived
Sept. 14. Aug. 30[?], lat. 45 33, long. 32 25, saw a Br. bark showing Mar-
ryat's 4,873[?] 1st dist. pendant; Aug. 30, lat. 46 40, long. 33 55, spoke Br.
ship Gorilla, from Liverpool for New-York, 19 days out; same day,
lat. 45 35, long. 35 18, saw a Br. ship, 3d pendant 2,168[?], Marryat; Sept.
4, lat. 43 20, long. 45 30, passed Brem. bark Atlantic for New-York.
